_comment: Source of truth for league rules. Verify against Sleeper's GET /v1/league/<league_id> scoring_settings + roster_positions on first run and fail loudly on mismatch.
_roster_comment: Verified against live roster_positions on 2026-09-23. There are NO IR slots -- the original transcription assumed 2. Confirmed twice: the league's roster_positions ends at the 4th BN, and the draft object's settings carry no slots_ir. SPEC §7.2's IR strategy (stashing injured stars at no active-roster cost) therefore does not apply to this league.
_from_live_settings: Read off the live league on 2026-09-23. These were absent from the original transcription and none of them are yet reflected in docs/SPEC.md. Values are Sleeper's, not inferred.

keepers._resolved: NO KEEPERS. Confirmed 2026-09-23 on three independent signals: settings.type=0 (redraft; 1=keeper, 2=dynasty), all 8 pre-draft rosters have players=[] and keepers=[], and the draft is 13 rounds for 13 roster spots, which leaves no room for a kept player. Sleeper still reports max_keepers=1 -- that is an inert platform default in a redraft league, NOT a league rule. Do not reopen this from that field alone.
keepers._previous_league_note: This league continues last season's. Nothing carries over, but that league's completed draft is real data for the M5 dress rehearsal (docs/TASKS.md M5, SPEC §9.6) -- a replayable 8-team snake draft with the same managers.

waivers._note: waiver_type=1 with waiver_budget=100 is FAAB bidding, not rolling priority. SPEC §7.3 ranks waiver targets but says nothing about what to bid.

draft_settings_live._note: The draft object's rounds=13 is the real value (13 x 8 = 104 picks, matching SPEC). The league-level settings.draft_rounds=3 is a stale default -- do not read it. start_time is still null, so the draft is not yet scheduled.

_scoring_comment: Key names are Sleeper's own, taken verbatim from the live GET /league/<id> scoring_settings on 2026-09-23, so verify_league compares them with no translation step. The five that were renamed from the original transcription (tpm<-fg3m, tf<-tech_foul, ff<-flagrant_foul, bonus_pt_40p<-bonus_40_pts, bonus_pt_50p<-bonus_50_pts) kept identical values, and the live payload has exactly these 13 keys and no others. engine/model/scoring.py maps them to readable box-score field names.

scoring_ambiguities._comment: Unresolved. Implement both branches behind these flags; default to the conservative reading and confirm with the commissioner or by inspecting a real box score in week 1.

bonuses_stack.question: Does a 50-point game score both bonus_40_pts and bonus_50_pts (7) or only bonus_50_pts (4)?

td_includes_dd.question: Does a triple-double also award the double-double bonus (7 total) or only the triple-double bonus (4)?

quadruple_double.question: Rare enough to ignore, but do not crash on it.

lock_in_rules.must_lock_before: that player's next game tips off
lock_in_rules.eligible_only_if: player was in the starting lineup when that game began
lock_in_rules.no_lock_fallback: team's final game of the week is used, which is 0 if the player did not play
lock_in_rules.post_lock: player's slot is fixed for the week and he cannot be moved or reused

strategy_constants._comment: Derived from the settings above. Used by the valuation engine.
